description: The official baseline and detailed original Coding Procedure remain pending; campaign-versus-event and local-versus-national unit rules cannot be finalized.
required_followup: Coordinator to recover and record the official baseline, version and permitted-use terms. Review repeated MIB dates and spatial scope against the detailed procedure without automatic merging.

description: The searches use open-web pooled results rather than systematic LexisNexis access or a complete local/regional newspaper archive. Date operators and returned result sets may be incomplete or off-period.
required_followup: Compare with licensed newspaper archives and Danish local/regional outlets by date and sector. Do not treat absence from these searches as absence of a gathering.

description: February 6 and February 27 are separate MIB gatherings, with January actions and a possible February 13 action in the same campaign context. Shared group name or anti-restriction theme does not establish one continuous episode or a single national unit.
required_followup: Review exact date/organization continuity and any inter-city structure in adjacent-month sources and the original procedure; preserve current day-level candidates pending review.

description: No physical end is documented for the February 6, February 27 or February 26 Wolt gatherings. For February 6, no event-specific state response is verified. For February 27, only eight arrests are reported; beating, dispersal, accommodation, ignoring, shooting and killing remain unknown. For Wolt, the saved prior-unit summary documents no state response; all response values remain unknown.
required_followup: Check contemporaneous police/event chronology and later reporting. Do not use a late-evening headcount, a policy announcement or a pay dispute as an episode end or state response; establish each physical end and response only from event-specific evidence.

description: The possible February 13 Men in Black action has only search-result and photo-caption evidence. Dagens.dk body retrieval returned a web-reader cache miss and then a DNS resolution failure on an ordinary HTTPS attempt; neither was a site denial. No headcount, exact demand or domestic state target is established.
required_followup: Use a fresh exact-URL access receipt, full publisher/origin review and immediate full-input hash recheck before any later attempt. If retrieved under normal access, verify event occurrence, turnout, demand and response.

description: A search-only Baptist.dk result suggests a February 9 Burmese/Myanmar gathering of about 300 at Rådhuspladsen concerning the coup. The article body was not opened; actual occurrence, crowd size and whether participants addressed Danish government policy remain unknown.
required_followup: Verify the gathering and attendance from accessible contemporary reporting, and determine whether any demand addressed Denmark or only Myanmar/international actors before inclusion or foreign-target exclusion.

description: Dagens.dk and NB-Økonomi each had two separately gated exact-URL retrieval attempts, but neither yielded an article body: Dagens returned a web-reader cache miss then DNS failure; NB-Økonomi returned an iframe shell then DNS failure. These were retrieval failures, not site denials. Baptist.dk requests were not sent because complete-corpus hashes changed after each saved manual gate. No alternate source copy or bypass was used.
required_followup: Keep the affected source cards search_only. Before any later request, create a fresh exact-URL receipt, save a complete contemporary publisher/origin review, and immediately compare the entire live input path/hash set; defer on any mismatch.

description: The captured Danish and English searches included Copenhagen/MIB dates and follow-ups but do not establish broad coverage across all municipalities, sectors, Greenland or Faroe Islands. The IMAGO search listing carries publication-territory terms; no image was accessed or reused. No captured Danish search invocation reported a robots or search-layer restriction.
required_followup: Extend systematic Danish-language searches across regional centers, labor/student/healthcare/housing sectors and territories, with event-date windows; use official and civil-society records where accessible. Preserve licensing limits and do not treat search silence as absence.

description: January forward-boundary continuation DK202101-C003 and exclusion DK202101-X001 point to a February 26 Wolt couriers public wage protest. The saved March 2 report summary gives approximately 100 participants protesting private-company pay and bonus cuts. Exact city/site, any Danish government-policy demand, and qualification of a private-employer target under the original rule remain unresolved; the January exclusion was only for being outside January.
required_followup: Review the original eligibility rule and any fuller accessible reporting to determine whether demands addressed Danish state policy or the employer alone; verify exact city/site, physical end and event-specific responses. Keep the candidate pending_state_target until resolved.
